correctness.rationale: The load-bearing multiplier is exactly the published homogeneous s-wave symbol. At \(\gamma_0=52/27\), setting \(t=\pi|k|/6\) reduces \(S_{\gamma_0}(k)\le S_{\gamma_0}(0)\) to \(F(t)=3t\cosh(3t)-\frac{13}{4}\sinh(3t)+\frac{27}{4}\sinh t\ge0\). Its power-series coefficient of \(t^{2n+1}\) is \([3^{2n+1}(8n-9)+27]/[4(2n+1)!]\): the first two vanish and every coefficient for \(n\ge2\) is positive, so the inequality is strict for \(t>0\). For \(\gamma>\gamma_0\), affine dependence on \(\gamma\) and \(\tanh x<x\) give strict decrease away from zero. The Taylor coefficient \(\pi^3(52-27\gamma)k^2/648\) makes zero fail even local maximality below the threshold. Since the quadratic form is multiplication by this continuous symbol, its optimal upper constant is its essential supremum. Independent direct evaluations reproduced the threshold behavior.
